        el('line', { x1: x(r.lo), x2: x(r.hi), y1: cy, y2: cy, stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2.4 }, g);
        [r.lo, r.hi].forEach(v => el('line', { x1: x(v), x2: x(v), y1: cy - 5, y2: cy + 5, stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2 }, g));
      }
      el(r.shape === 'circle' ? 'circle' : 'rect', r.shape === 'circle' ? { cx: x(r.est), cy, r: 6, fill: col } : { x: x(r.est) - 5.5, y: cy - 5.5, width: 11, height: 11, fill: col }, g);
    }
    if (showVals) { const vt = el('text', { x: W - valW + 6, y: cy + 4, 'font-size': fs, 'font-weight': r.kind === 'pool' ? 700 : 400, fill: 'var(--ink)', style: 'font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums' }, svg); vt.textContent = vals[i]; }
    markify(g, r.aria || (r.label + ': ' + vals[i]), r.tip || ('<b>' + esc(r.label) + '</b><br>' + vals[i]));
  });
  return svg;
}

/* Horizontal bar chart. rows: {label, v, color, tip}; bars start at zero. */
function hbars(container, rows, o) {
  container.innerHTML = '';
  const W = width(container); const fs = W < 480 ? 12 : 13; const rowH = o.rowH || 30;
  const labW = Math.min(W * 0.5, Math.max(...rows.map(r => textW(r.label, fs)))) + 10;
  const vals = rows.map(r => r.valText || num(r.v, o.d == null ? 2 : o.d));
  const valW = Math.max(...vals.map(v => textW(v, fs))) + 10;
  const m = { l: labW, r: valW + 6, t: 6, b: o.xLabel ? 44 : 22 };
  const H = m.t + m.b + rows.length * rowH;
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, width: W, height: H, role: 'group', 'aria-label': o.aria || 'bar chart' }, container);
  let lo = Math.min(0, ...rows.map(r => r.v)), hi = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => r.v));
  if (o.domain) { lo = Math.min(lo, o.domain[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, o.domain[1]); }
  if (hi === lo) hi = lo + 1;
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r; const x = v => m.l + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * pw;
  const { ticks, step } = niceTicks(lo, hi, Math.max(2, Math.floor(pw / 70)));
  ticks.forEach(t => {
    el('line', { x1: x(t), x2: x(t), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, stroke: 'var(--grid)' }, svg);
    const tx = el('text', { x: x(t), y: H - m.b + 15, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, class: 'tick' }, svg); tx.textContent = tickLabel(t, step);
  });
  el('line', { x1: x(0), x2: x(0), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, stroke: 'var(--ink)', 'stroke-width': 1 }, svg);
  if (o.xLabel) { const at = el('text', { x: m.l + pw / 2, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, fill: 'var(--muted)' }, svg); at.textContent = o.xLabel; }
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const cy = m.t + i * rowH + rowH / 2;
    const lt = el('text', { x: m.l - 10, y: cy + 4, 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': fs }, svg); lt.textContent = r.label;
    const g = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('rect', { class: 'hit', x: m.l, y: cy - rowH / 2 + 2, width: pw, height: rowH - 4, fill: 'transparent', rx: 3 }, g);
    const a = x(Math.min(0, r.v)), b = x(Math.max(0, r.v));
    el('rect', { x: a, y: cy - rowH * 0.3, width: Math.max(1, b - a), height: rowH * 0.6, fill: r.color || 'var(--accent)', rx: 2 }, g);
    const vt = el('text', { x: W - valW + 2, y: cy + 4, 'font-size': fs, style: 'font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums' }, svg); vt.textContent = vals[i];
    markify(g, r.label + ': ' + vals[i], r.tip || ('<b>' + esc(r.label) + '</b><br>' + vals[i]));
  });
}

/* ====================== 1. THE FINDING ====================== */
const BODY = {
  B2_PHYS: 'Physical Sciences', B2_LIFEENV: 'Life & Environment', B2_SOC: 'Social Sciences', B2_MATHDEC: 'Math & Decision',
  B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14: '2010–14 cohort', B4_COHORT_2015_17: '2015–17 cohort', B1_DEV: 'DEV (selection)'
};
const radio = name => document.querySelector(`input[name="${name}"]:checked`).value;
function renderFinding() {
  const feat = radio('f-feature'), rung = radio('f-rung'), dev = $('#f-dev').checked;
  const pool = EV.pools[feat + '|' + rung];
  const order = ['B2_PHYS', 'B2_LIFEENV', 'B2_SOC', 'B2_MATHDEC', 'B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14', 'B4_COHORT_2015_17'];
  const rows = [];
  order.forEach(b => {
    const r = EV.bodies.find(x => x.body === b && x.feature === feat); if (!r || !r[rung]) return;
    const inPool = pool.bodies.includes(b); const c = r[rung];
    const label = BODY[b] + (inPool ? '' : ' (selection)') + ' n=' + int(c.n);
    rows.push({ label, est: c.psp, lo: c.lo, hi: c.hi, kind: inPool ? 'body' : 'sel', band: rung === 'R2' ? r.placebo_p95 : null,
      tip: `<b>${esc(BODY[b])}</b> (onsets ${esc(r.onsets || '')})<br>${esc(feat.replace('_', ' '))} at ${rung}: ${sgn(c.psp, 3)} ${ci(c.lo, c.hi, 3, true)}<br>n = ${int(c.n)} concepts; ${inPool ? 'pooled' : 'selection body, not pooled'}${r.placebo_p95 != null && rung === 'R2' ? '<br>placebo 95th pct |PSP| ' + num(r.placebo_p95, 3) : ''}` });
  });
  rows.push({ label: 'DL pool, ' + pool.k + ' bodies', est: pool.est, lo: pool.lo, hi: pool.hi, kind: 'pool', sep: true,
    tip: `<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b><br>${sgn(pool.est, 3)} ${ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true)}<br>I² = ${num(pool.I2, 2)}, ${pool.sign} positive` });
  if (dev) {
    const r = EV.bodies.find(x => x.body === 'B1_DEV' && x.feature === feat)[rung];
    rows.push({ label: 'DEV (selection) n=' + int(r.n), est: r.psp, lo: r.lo, hi: r.hi, kind: 'sel', sep: true,
      tip: `<b>DEV selection body</b><br>${sgn(r.psp, 3)} ${ci(r.lo, r.hi, 3, true)}<br>Not pooled: the index was chosen here.` });
  }
  forest($('#c-finding'), rows, { xLabel: 'Partial Spearman with O₂r (m = 50), net of rung controls', ref: pool.est, aria: 'Forest plot of partial Spearman by body' });
  const bodyRows = rows.filter(r => r.kind === 'body');
  const exclude0 = bodyRows.filter(r => r.lo > 0).length;
  const fname = feat === 'OPEN_home' ? 'OPENₕₒₘₑ'.replace('ₕₒₘₑ', 'home') : 'NOVCHURN home';
  $('#t-finding').textContent = `At ${rung}, ${feat.replace('_', ' ')} pools to ${sgn(pool.est, 3)} ${ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true)} over ${pool.k} non-selection bodies (I² = ${num(pool.I2, 2)}, ${pool.sign} positive), but only ${exclude0} of ${bodyRows.length} bodies have an individual CI above zero. The DEV body, where the index was chosen, gives ${sgn(pool.sel_est, 3)}: ${num(pool.shrink, 2)}× the pool.`;
  void fname;
}
function headline() {
  const p = EV.pools['OPEN_home|R2'];
  $('#headNum').textContent = sgn(p.est, 3);
  $('#headNumCap').innerHTML = `Pooled partial Spearman of OPEN<sub>home</sub> with O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50) at rung R2, 95% CI ${ci(p.lo, p.hi, 3, true)}, I<sup>2</sup> = ${num(p.I2, 0)}, ${p.sign} bodies positive (DerSimonian–Laird, ${p.k} non-selection bodies).`;
}

/* ====================== 2. STEPPER ====================== */
const COMP = CA.components; // [name, sign]
const COMPLABEL = { new_edge_rate: 'New edge rate', n_comm_W3: 'Leiden communities reached', participation: 'Participation coefficient', NOV_res: 'Novelty residual NOV_res', ego_density_W3: 'Ego density', edge_persistence: 'Edge persistence' };
function openFrom(comp, build) {
  const z = CA.zconst[build]; const parts = [];
  COMP.forEach(([k, s]) => { const v = comp[k]; if (v == null || !isFinite(v)) { parts.push({ k, s, v: null, z: null }); return; } parts.push({ k, s, v, z: s * (v - z[k].mean) / z[k].sd }); });
  const fin = parts.filter(p => p.z != null);
  return { parts, open: fin.length >= 4 ? fin.reduce((a, p) => a + p.z, 0) / fin.length : null, n: fin.length };
}
function partnerOf(c) { return CA.cases.find(x => x.pair === c.pair && x.role !== c.role); }
function caseLabel(c) { return c.name + ' (' + (c.role === 'HIGH_OPEN' ? 'high' : 'low') + ' OPEN, ' + c.group + ')'; }
const STAGES = [
  { short: 'Ground', title: '1. Ground the concept and date its onset' },
  { short: 'B5', title: '2. Measure early popularity: the B5 baseline' },
  { short: 'Ego net', title: '3. Build the early co-occurrence ego network' },
  { short: 'OPEN', title: '4. Score six components and average them into OPEN' },
  { short: 'Spread', title: '5. Follow the spread to t₀+8' },
  { short: 'Outcome', title: '6. Score the outcome: rarefied breadth' },
  { short: 'Pool', title: '7. Correlate across thousands of concepts' }
];
let stage = 0;
function kv(pairs) { return '<dl class="kv">' + pairs.map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd>`).join('') + '</dl>'; }
function drawPipeline() {
  const c = $('#c-pipeline'); c.innerHTML = '';
  const W = width(c); const cols = W < 600 ? 4 : 7; const rowsN = Math.ceil(STAGES.length / cols);
  const gap = 8, bh = 46; const bw = (W - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols; const H = rowsN * bh + (rowsN - 1) * 14 + 4;
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, width: W, height: H, role: 'list', 'aria-label': 'Method stages' }, c);
  STAGES.forEach((s, i) => {
    const col = i % cols, row = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = col * (bw + gap), y = row * (bh + 14) + 2;
    const cur = i === stage, done = i < stage;
    const g = el('g', { role: 'listitem' }, svg);
    const a = el('a', { href: '#stepper', tabindex: '0', role: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Stage ' + (i + 1) + ': ' + s.title.replace(/^\d\. /, '') }, g);
    if (cur) a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step');
    el('rect', { x, y, width: bw, height: bh, rx: 8, fill: cur ? 'var(--accent)' : done ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : '#fff', stroke: cur ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--line)', 'stroke-width': 1.5, class: 'hit' }, a);
    const fs = Math.min(14, bw / 6.2);
    const t1 = el('text', { x: x + bw / 2, y: y + 18, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs * 0.85, fill: cur ? '#fff' : 'var(--muted)' }, a); t1.textContent = 'Stage ' + (i + 1);
    const t2 = el('text', { x: x + bw / 2, y: y + 36, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, 'font-weight': 700, fill: cur ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink)' }, a); t2.textContent = s.short;
    a.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); setStage(i, true); });
    a.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setStage(i, true); } });
    if (i < STAGES.length - 1 && col < cols - 1) el('path', { d: `M${x + bw + 1},${y + bh / 2} l${gap - 2},0`, stroke: 'var(--faint)', 'stroke-width': 1.5 }, svg);
  });
}
function setStage(i, focusMarker) {
  stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i));
  drawPipeline(); renderStage();
  $('#s-prev').disabled = stage === 0; $('#s-next').disabled = stage === STAGES.length - 1;
  $('#s-live').textContent = 'Stage ' + (stage + 1) + ' of ' + STAGES.length + ': ' + STAGES[stage].title.replace(/^\d\. /, '');
  if (focusMarker) { const m = $('#c-pipeline a[aria-current="step"]'); if (m) m.focus(); }
}
function renderStage() {
  const c = CA.cases[+$('#s-concept').value]; const p = partnerOf(c);
  const S = STAGES[stage]; $('#s-title').textContent = S.title.replace('t₀', 't0');
  $('#s-title').innerHTML = esc(S.title).replace('t₀+8', 't<sub>0</sub>+8');
  const chart = $('#c-stage'); chart.innerHTML = '';
  const nm = esc(c.name), pn = esc(p.name);
  let why = '', inn = '', out = '', take = '';
  if (stage === 0) {
    why = 'Concepts are found by Aho–Corasick title matching of 56,643 legacy OpenAlex concepts, with an LLM precision gate. The onset year fixes a common clock: early signals come from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2 and the outcome from t<sub>0</sub>+6 to t<sub>0</sub>+8, so no early measure sees the outcome window.';
    inn = kv([['Concept', nm], ['Reporting group', esc(c.rgroup)], ['Matched partner', pn]]);
    out = kv([['Onset year t<sub>0</sub>', c.t0], ['Early window', c.t0 + '–' + (c.t0 + 2)], ['Outcome window', (c.t0 + 6) + '–' + (c.t0 + 8)], ['Home group', esc(c.group)]]);
    take = `${c.name} reached 20 grounded papers in ${c.t0}; its partner ${p.name} did so in ${p.t0}, within the two-year matching tolerance.`;
  } else if (stage === 1) {
    why = 'B5 is what any forecaster would try first. Every indicator in the study is judged by what it adds beyond these five numbers, and the pair was matched on the first two.';
    const b = c.B5, q = p.B5;
    inn = kv([['Papers in t<sub>0</sub>..t<sub>0</sub>+2', 'grounded, by venue field']]);
    out = '<table><thead><tr><th>B5 feature</th><th>' + nm + '</th><th>' + pn + '</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      [['log early volume', 'logvol'], ['growth', 'growth_c'], ['non-home share', 'offhome_share'], ['field entropy', 'entropy'], ['field reach', 'reach']]
        .map(([l, k]) => `<tr><td>${l}</td><td>${num(b[k], k === 'reach' ? 0 : 3)}</td><td>${num(q[k], k === 'reach' ? 0 : 3)}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    hbars(chart, [{ label: c.name + ' log volume', v: b.logvol, color: 'var(--accent)' }, { label: p.name + ' log volume', v: q.logvol, color: 'var(--base)' }], { d: 3, xLabel: 'log early volume (t0..t0+2)', aria: 'Early volume of the pair' });
    take = `Early volume is almost identical (${num(b.logvol, 3)} vs ${num(q.logvol, 3)}), so a size-based forecast treats the two alike; their non-home shares (${num(b.offhome_share, 2)} vs ${num(q.offhome_share, 2)}) already differ.`;
  } else if (stage === 2) {
    why = 'The ego network holds the concept’s positive-PMI neighbour topics on the topic backbone and the links among them. It is rebuilt for the first, first two and first three years (W1–W3), which is what the novelty and persistence components compare.';
    const s = c.snap, t = p.snap;
    inn = '<p class="small" style="margin:0 0 6px">Top W3 neighbour topics (PMI, papers):</p><ul style="margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:15px">' + c.nbrs.map(n => `<li>${esc(n[0])} <span class="small">(${num(n[1], 2)}, ${n[2]})</span></li>`).join('') + '</ul>';
    out = '<table><thead><tr><th>Window (all papers)</th><th>topics</th><th>links</th><th>communities</th><th>density</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      ['W1_all', 'W2_all', 'W3_all', 'W3_home'].filter(k => s[k]).map(k => `<tr><td>${k.replace('_all', '').replace('_home', ' home only')}</td><td>${s[k].n_nodes}</td><td>${s[k].n_edges}</td><td>${s[k].n_communities}</td><td>${num(s[k].density, 2)}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    const rows = [];
    ['W1_all', 'W2_all', 'W3_all'].forEach(k => { if (s[k]) rows.push({ label: c.name.slice(0, 22) + ' ' + k.slice(0, 2), v: s[k].n_nodes, color: 'var(--accent)' }); if (t[k]) rows.push({ label: p.name.slice(0, 22) + ' ' + k.slice(0, 2), v: t[k].n_nodes, color: 'var(--base)' }); });
    hbars(chart, rows, { d: 0, xLabel: 'neighbour topics in the ego network', aria: 'Ego network size by window', rowH: 26 });
    const a = s.W3_all, bb = t.W3_all;
    take = a && bb ? `By W3, ${c.name} has ${a.n_nodes} neighbour topics in ${a.n_communities} communities (density ${num(a.density, 2)}); ${p.name} has ${bb.n_nodes} in ${bb.n_communities} (density ${num(bb.density, 2)}).` : '';
  } else if (stage === 3) {
    why = 'Each component is z-scored with constants fitted on all 12,499 frame concepts; ego density and edge persistence enter with a negative sign, so consolidation lowers OPEN. The index is the mean of the available z-scores (at least four of six).';
    const R = openFrom(c.comp.home, 'home'); const Ra = openFrom(c.comp.all, 'all');
    inn = '<table><thead><tr><th>Home component</th><th>value</th><th>signed z</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + R.parts.map(q => `<tr><td>${COMPLABEL[q.k]}${q.s < 0 ? ' (−)' : ''}</td><td>${q.v == null ? 'missing' : num(q.v, 3)}</td><td>${q.z == null ? '–' : sgn(q.z, 2)}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    out = kv([['OPEN<sub>home</sub>, computed here', sgn(R.open, 3)], ['OPEN<sub>home</sub>, recorded', sgn(c.OPEN.home, 3)], ['OPEN<sub>all</sub>, computed here', sgn(Ra.open, 3)], ['OPEN<sub>all</sub>, recorded', sgn(c.OPEN.all, 3)], ['Partner OPEN<sub>all</sub>', sgn(p.OPEN.all, 3)]]);
    hbars(chart, R.parts.filter(q => q.z != null).map(q => ({ label: COMPLABEL[q.k], v: q.z, color: q.z >= 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--neg)' })), { d: 2, xLabel: 'signed z-score (home build)', aria: 'Signed component z-scores' });
    const top = R.parts.filter(q => q.z != null).sort((a, b) => b.z - a.z)[0];
    take = `${c.name}'s OPEN_home is ${sgn(R.open, 3)}, recomputed here from its ${R.n} home components and equal to the recorded value; its largest push comes from ${COMPLABEL[top.k].toLowerCase()} (${sgn(top.z, 2)}).`;
  } else if (stage === 4) {
    why = 'Retained off-home breadth at t<sub>0</sub>+8 splits exactly into early contact (fields entered by t<sub>0</sub>+2, E<sub>2</sub>), frontier advance (M = fields ever entered by t<sub>0</sub>+8 / E<sub>2</sub>) and retention (ρ = retained / ever entered). This is an accounting identity, not a causal model.';
    const d = c.dec, e = p.dec;
    inn = kv([['Off-home fields entered by t<sub>0</sub>+2 (E<sub>2</sub>)', d.E2], ['Ever entered by t<sub>0</sub>+8', d.EH]]);
    out = kv([['Frontier advance M', num(d.M, 3)], ['Retention ρ', num(d.rho, 3)], ['Retained at t<sub>0</sub>+8 (E<sub>2</sub>·M·ρ)', num(d.Bn, 0)], ['Partner: E<sub>2</sub> / retained', e.E2 + ' / ' + num(e.Bn, 0)]]);
    hbars(chart, [
      { label: c.name.slice(0, 24) + ' E2', v: d.E2, color: 'var(--accent)' }, { label: p.name.slice(0, 24) + ' E2', v: e.E2, color: 'var(--base)' },
      { label: c.name.slice(0, 24) + ' retained', v: d.Bn, color: 'var(--accent)' }, { label: p.name.slice(0, 24) + ' retained', v: e.Bn, color: 'var(--base)' }], { d: 0, xLabel: 'off-home venue fields', aria: 'Fields entered early and retained', rowH: 26 });
    take = `${c.name} contacted ${d.E2} off-home fields by t0+2 and kept ${num(d.Bn, 0)} at t0+8; ${p.name} contacted ${e.E2} and kept ${num(e.Bn, 0)}. Across DEV, early contact accounts for most of such gaps.`;
  } else if (stage === 5) {
    why = 'Raw field counts grow with volume. Rarefaction asks how many venue fields a random 50 of the concept’s t<sub>0</sub>+6..t<sub>0</sub>+8 papers would span; the size-adjusted version subtracts what the concept’s volume predicts.';
    inn = kv([['Papers in t<sub>0</sub>+6..t<sub>0</sub>+8', 'rarefied to m = 50']]);
    out = kv([['O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50)', num(c.O2r_m50, 2)], ['Size-adjusted residual', sgn(c.O2r_resid, 2)], ['Partner O<sub>2r</sub>', num(p.O2r_m50, 2)], ['Partner residual', sgn(p.O2r_resid, 2)]]);
    hbars(chart, [{ label: c.name, v: c.O2r_m50, color: 'var(--accent)' }, { label: p.name, v: p.O2r_m50, color: 'var(--base)' }], { d: 2, xLabel: 'expected distinct venue fields in 50 papers', aria: 'Rarefied breadth of the pair' });
    const hiC = c.role === 'HIGH_OPEN' ? c : p, loC = c.role === 'HIGH_OPEN' ? p : c;
    take = `The high-OPEN member (${hiC.name}) spans ${num(hiC.O2r_m50, 2)} fields per 50 papers against ${num(loC.O2r_m50, 2)} for ${loC.name}. One pair illustrates; it does not test.`;
  } else {
    const pool = EV.pools['OPEN_home|R2'];
    why = 'A single pair proves nothing. The test ranks thousands of concepts on OPEN<sub>home</sub> and on breadth, removes B5 and the rung controls from both ranks, and correlates what is left, body by body, then pools the bodies.';
    inn = kv([['Concepts per body', 'n = 86 to 1,993'], ['Controls (R2)', 'B5 + onset year + contact reach + type + generic flag + level']]);
    out = kv([['Pooled PSP, 6 non-selection bodies', sgn(pool.est, 3)], ['95% CI', ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true)], ['DEV (selection) PSP', sgn(pool.sel_est, 3)]]);
    hbars(chart, [{ label: 'DEV selection body', v: pool.sel_est, color: 'var(--base)' }, { label: 'Non-selection pool', v: pool.est, color: 'var(--accent)' }], { d: 3, xLabel: 'partial Spearman with O2r (m = 50) at R2', aria: 'Selection versus non-selection estimate' });
    take = `Across concepts, OPEN_home and later breadth share a partial Spearman of ${sgn(pool.est, 3)}: real in sign everywhere, small in size, and ${num(pool.shrink, 2)}× smaller than on the body where the index was chosen.`;
  }
  $('#s-why').innerHTML = why; $('#s-in').innerHTML = inn; $('#s-out').innerHTML = out; $('#t-stage').textContent = take;
}

/* ====================== 3. INDICATOR SCREEN ====================== */
const IND = {
  M0_density_end: ['Frontier density (period end)', 'FR'], D_vol_end: ['Volume-weighted field density', 'FR'], CONTACT_REACH: ['Contact reach', 'FR'],
  n_comm_W3: ['Communities reached (W3)', 'A'], NOV: ['Novelty residual NOV_res', 'A'], RETENTION_RATIO_early: ['Retention ratio', 'FR'],
  ego_density_W3: ['Ego density (W3)', 'A'], RS: ['Rao–Stirling', 'G'], G_btw: ['Gateway betweenness G_btw', 'G'], log_offhome_volume: ['log off-home volume', 'F']
};
const UNIT = { PHYS: 'Physical Sciences', LIFEENV: 'Life & Environment', SOC: 'Social Sciences', MATHDEC: 'Math & Decision', COH_DEVHOME: '2010–14 cohort, DEV homes', COH_OTHER: '2010–14 cohort, other homes' };
function renderScreen() {
  const only = $('#sc-conf').checked; const sel = $('#sc-sel').value;
  const list = SC.indicators.filter(d => !only || d.confirmed);
  const rows = list.map(d => ({ label: IND[d.id][0], est: d.pooled, lo: d.lo, hi: d.hi, kind: 'body', shape: 'circle', color: d.id === sel ? 'var(--ink)' : d.confirmed ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--base)',
    tip: `<b>${esc(IND[d.id][0])}</b> (family ${IND[d.id][1]})<br>pooled PSP ${sgn(d.pooled, 3)} ${ci(d.lo, d.hi, 3, true)}<br>I² ${num(d.I2, 2)}, sign ${d.sign}, ${d.confirmed ? 'confirmed' : 'not confirmed'}` }));
  forest($('#c-screen'), rows, { xLabel: 'Pooled held-out PSP with O₂r (m = 50)', values: false, aria: 'Pooled partial Spearman by indicator' });
  $('#c-screen').querySelectorAll('.mark').forEach((g, i) => g.addEventListener('click', () => { $('#sc-sel').value = list[i].id; renderScreen(); }));
  const d = SC.indicators.find(x => x.id === sel);
  const urows = d.units.map(u => ({ label: UNIT[u.unit] + ' n=' + int(u.n), est: u.rho, lo: u.lo, hi: u.hi, kind: 'body', shape: 'circle', color: u.lo > 0 || u.hi < 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--base)',
    tip: `<b>${esc(UNIT[u.unit])}</b><br>${sgn(u.rho, 3)} ${ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3, true)}, n = ${int(u.n)}` }));
  urows.push({ label: 'DL pool', est: d.pooled, lo: d.lo, hi: d.hi, kind: 'pool', sep: true, tip: `<b>Pooled</b> ${sgn(d.pooled, 3)} ${ci(d.lo, d.hi, 3, true)}, I² ${num(d.I2, 2)}` });
  forest($('#c-units'), urows, { xLabel: IND[d.id][0] + ': PSP by held-out unit', values: false, aria: 'Per-unit estimates for ' + IND[d.id][0] });
  const excl = d.units.filter(u => u.lo > 0 || u.hi < 0).length;
  $('#t-screen').textContent = `${SC.n_confirmed} of ${SC.n_top10} DEV-selected indicators are confirmed. ${IND[d.id][0]} pools to ${sgn(d.pooled, 3)} ${ci(d.lo, d.hi, 3, true)} with sign agreement ${d.sign} and I² = ${num(d.I2, 2)}; ${excl} of ${d.units.length} units have a CI that excludes zero, so it is ${d.confirmed ? 'confirmed' : 'not confirmed'}.`;
}

/* ====================== 4. ITEM BROWSER ====================== */
const ROWS = CO.rows; let selId = null; let shown = 60;
ROWS.forEach(r => { r.res = (r.y != null && r.pB5 != null) ? r.y - r.pB5 : null; });
function filtered() {
  const q = $('#b-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(), g = $('#b-group').value, sc = $('#b-scored').checked, s = $('#b-sort').value;
  let L = ROWS.filter(r => (!q || r.c.toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (g === 'all' || r.g === g) && (!sc || (r.y != null && r.oh != null && r.pB5 != null && r.pOP != null)));
  const key = { open: r => r.oh == null ? -1e9 : r.oh, resid: r => r.res == null ? -1e9 : r.res, miss: r => r.res == null ? -1e9 : Math.abs(r.res) };
  if (s === 'name') L.sort((a, b) => a.c.localeCompare(b.c)); else L.sort((a, b) => key[s](b) - key[s](a));
  return L;
}
function renderList() {
  const L = filtered(); const box = $('#b-list'); box.innerHTML = '';
  const ul = document.createElement('ul');
  L.slice(0, shown).forEach(r => {
    const li = document.createElement('li'); const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button';
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', r.id === selId ? 'true' : 'false');
    b.innerHTML = `<span>${esc(r.c)}<br><span class="meta">${r.t0} · ${esc(r.g)}</span></span><span class="meta">OPEN ${r.oh == null ? '–' : sgn(r.oh, 2)}<br>O2r ${r.y == null ? '–' : num(r.y, 2)}</span>`;
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { selId = r.id; renderList(); renderDetail(); });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  box.appendChild(ul);
  if (L.length > shown) { const m = document.createElement('button'); m.type = 'button'; m.className = 'btn'; m.style.margin = '10px'; m.textContent = 'Show 60 more'; m.addEventListener('click', () => { shown += 60; renderList(); }); box.appendChild(m); }
  const both = L.filter(r => r.y != null && r.pB5 != null && r.pOP != null);
  const closer = both.filter(r => Math.abs(r.y - r.pOP) < Math.abs(r.y - r.pB5)).length;
  $('#b-status').textContent = `${int(L.length)} of ${int(ROWS.length)} concepts match. Among the ${int(both.length)} with both forecasts and an outcome, adding OPEN_home moves the forecast closer for ${int(closer)} (${both.length ? Math.round(100 * closer / both.length) : 0}%).`;
  if (!L.find(r => r.id === selId) && L.length) { selId = L[0].id; renderList(); renderDetail(); return; }
  if (!L.length) { $('#b-detail').innerHTML = '<p>No concept matches these filters.</p>'; $('#c-detail').innerHTML = ''; $('#t-browser').textContent = 'No concept matches; clear the search or the filters.'; }
}
function renderDetail() {
  const r = ROWS.find(x => x.id === selId); if (!r) return;
  const pills = [];
  if (r.res != null) pills.push(r.res > 0 ? '<span class="pill good">broader than B5 forecast</span>' : '<span class="pill bad">narrower than B5 forecast</span>');
  if (r.oh == null) pills.push('<span class="pill">OPEN_home not defined (&lt;10 home papers or &lt;4 components)</span>');
  $('#b-detail').innerHTML = `<h4 style="font-size:19px;margin:0 0 4px">${esc(r.c)}</h4><p class="small" style="margin:0 0 8px">OpenAlex ${esc(r.id)} · onset ${r.t0} · home group ${esc(r.g)} · type ${esc(r.type || 'unlabelled')}</p>${pills.join(' ')}
  <div class="stagebody" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="io"><h4>Input: early window</h4>${kv([['log early volume', num(r.lv, 3)], ['growth', num(r.gr, 3)], ['non-home share', num(r.sh, 3)], ['field entropy', num(r.en, 3)], ['field reach', r.re], ['home papers t<sub>0</sub>..t<sub>0</sub>+2', r.nh], ['OPEN<sub>home</sub>', r.oh == null ? 'n/a' : sgn(r.oh, 3)], ['OPEN<sub>all</sub>', r.oa == null ? 'n/a' : sgn(r.oa, 3)]])}</div>
  <div class="io"><h4>Output: forecasts and outcome</h4>${kv([['B5 forecast', num(r.pB5, 2)], ['B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> forecast', num(r.pOP, 2)], ['Recorded O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50)', num(r.y, 2)], ['Recorded minus B5', r.res == null ? 'n/a' : sgn(r.res, 2)]])}</div></div>`;
  const bars = [];
  if (r.pB5 != null) bars.push({ label: 'B5 forecast', v: r.pB5, color: 'var(--base)' });
  if (r.pOP != null) bars.push({ label: 'B5 + OPEN_home', v: r.pOP, color: 'var(--accent)' });
  if (r.y != null) bars.push({ label: 'Recorded breadth', v: r.y, color: 'var(--ink)' });
  if (bars.length) hbars($('#c-detail'), bars, { d: 2, xLabel: 'distinct venue fields per 50 papers (O2r, m = 50)', aria: 'Forecasts and outcome for ' + r.c, domain: [0, 12] }); else $('#c-detail').innerHTML = '';
  let t;
  if (r.y != null && r.pB5 != null && r.pOP != null) {
    const moved = r.pOP - r.pB5; const closer = Math.abs(r.y - r.pOP) < Math.abs(r.y - r.pB5);
    t = `${r.c}: B5 forecasts ${num(r.pB5, 2)} fields, adding OPEN_home moves it by ${sgn(moved, 2)} to ${num(r.pOP, 2)}, and the recorded breadth is ${num(r.y, 2)}; the OPEN term moved the forecast ${closer ? 'closer to' : 'away from'} the outcome, by less than B5 missed it.`;
    if (Math.abs(moved) >= Math.abs(r.y - r.pB5)) t = t.replace(', by less than B5 missed it', '');
  } else if (r.y != null && r.pB5 != null) t = `${r.c} has no OPEN_home, so only the B5 forecast (${num(r.pB5, 2)}) can be set against its recorded breadth (${num(r.y, 2)}).`;
  else t = `${r.c} has no recorded O2r (m = 50) outcome: fewer than 50 papers in t0+6..t0+8 or a truncated window, so it cannot be scored.`;
  $('#t-browser').textContent = t;
}

/* ====================== 5. MATCHED PAIRS ====================== */
function renderPairs() {
  const b = radio('p-build'), o = radio('p-out');
  const pairs = [...new Set(CA.cases.map(c => c.pair))];
  const rows = []; let agree = 0, agreeOpen = 0;
  pairs.forEach(pid => {
    const h = CA.cases.find(c => c.pair === pid && c.role === 'HIGH_OPEN'), l = CA.cases.find(c => c.pair === pid && c.role === 'LOW_OPEN');
    const vo = c => o === 'Bn' ? c.dec.Bn : c.O2r_resid;
    const hiIsMore = h.OPEN[b] >= l.OPEN[b];
    const moreOpen = hiIsMore ? h : l, lessOpen = hiIsMore ? l : h;
    if (vo(moreOpen) > vo(lessOpen)) agree++;
    if (hiIsMore) agreeOpen++;
    [moreOpen, lessOpen].forEach((c, j) => rows.push({ label: c.name.length > 30 ? c.name.slice(0, 29) + '…' : c.name, v: vo(c), color: j === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--base)',
      tip: `<b>${esc(c.name)}</b> (${esc(c.group)}, t₀ ${c.t0})<br>OPEN_${b} ${sgn(c.OPEN[b], 3)}<br>${o === 'Bn' ? 'retained off-home fields at t₀+8: ' + num(c.dec.Bn, 0) : 'size-adjusted breadth ' + sgn(c.O2r_resid, 2)}` }));
  });
  hbars($('#c-pairs'), rows, { d: o === 'Bn' ? 0 : 2, xLabel: o === 'Bn' ? 'off-home fields retained at t0+8' : 'size-adjusted breadth O2r residual', aria: 'Matched pairs outcome', rowH: 24 });
  $('#t-pairs').textContent = `Ordering each pair by OPEN_${b} (the more open member is drawn first, in blue), the more open member has the ${o === 'Bn' ? 'larger retained breadth' : 'higher size-adjusted breadth'} in ${agree} of ${pairs.length} pairs.` + (b === 'home' ? ` OPEN_home agrees with OPEN_all on which member is more open in ${agreeOpen} of ${pairs.length} pairs.` : '');
}

/* ====================== 6. OPEN CALCULATOR ====================== */
const RANGES = { new_edge_rate: [0, 2, 0.01], n_comm_W3: [0, 10, 1], participation: [0, 1, 0.01], NOV_res: [-1, 0.2, 0.01], ego_density_W3: [0, 1, 0.01], edge_persistence: [0, 1, 0.01] };
let calcVals = {};
function setupCalc() {
  const c = CA.cases[+$('#k-concept').value]; const b = radio('k-build');
  calcVals = Object.assign({}, c.comp[b]);
  const box = $('#k-sliders'); box.innerHTML = '';
  COMP.forEach(([k, s]) => {
    const [mn, mx, st] = RANGES[k]; const v = calcVals[k];
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'rangeRow'; wrap.style.marginBottom = '4px';
    const id = 'k-' + k;
    wrap.innerHTML = `<label for="${id}" class="small" style="grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:600">${COMPLABEL[k]} ${s < 0 ? '(enters with − sign)' : '(enters with + sign)'}</label>`;
    const inp = document.createElement('input'); inp.type = 'range'; inp.id = id; inp.min = mn; inp.max = mx; inp.step = st;
    const out = document.createElement('output'); out.setAttribute('for', id);
    if (v == null) { inp.disabled = true; inp.value = mn; out.textContent = 'missing'; } else { inp.value = v; out.textContent = num(v, k === 'n_comm_W3' ? 0 : 3); }
    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { calcVals[k] = +inp.value; out.textContent = num(+inp.value, k === 'n_comm_W3' ? 0 : 3); renderCalc(); });
    wrap.appendChild(inp); wrap.appendChild(out); box.appendChild(wrap);
  });
  renderCalc();
}
function renderCalc() {
  const c = CA.cases[+$('#k-concept').value]; const b = radio('k-build');
  const R = openFrom(calcVals, b); const rec = c.OPEN_full[b];
  hbars($('#c-calc'), R.parts.filter(q => q.z != null).map(q => ({ label: COMPLABEL[q.k], v: q.z, color: q.z >= 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--neg)' })).concat([{ label: 'OPEN (mean)', v: R.open, color: 'var(--ink)' }]), { d: 2, xLabel: 'signed z-score', aria: 'Component z-scores and OPEN', domain: [-2, 2] });
  const same = R.open != null && rec != null && Math.abs(R.open - rec) < 1e-9;
  $('#k-result').innerHTML = `OPEN<sub>${b}</sub> = ${sgn(R.open, 3)} · recorded for ${esc(c.name)}: ${sgn(rec, 3)} ${same ? '<span class="pill good">exact match</span>' : '<span class="pill">edited</span>'}`;
  const orig = openFrom(c.comp[b], b);
  $('#t-calc').textContent = same
    ? `With ${c.name}'s recorded components the page reproduces the run's OPEN_${b} of ${sgn(rec, 3)} to machine precision. Move a slider to see how far one component can shift the index.`
    : `Your edited components give OPEN_${b} = ${sgn(R.open, 3)}, a change of ${sgn(R.open - orig.open, 3)} from ${c.name}'s recorded ${sgn(rec, 3)}. Each component contributes one sixth of its z-score.`;
}

/* ====================== 7. WHAT-IF THRESHOLD ====================== */
const SCORED = ROWS.filter(r => r.y != null && r.oh != null && r.pB5 != null && r.pOP != null);
function ranks(a) { const idx = a.map((v, i) => [v, i]).sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]); const r = new Array(a.length); let i = 0; while (i < idx.length) { let j = i; while (j + 1 < idx.length && idx[j + 1][0] === idx[i][0]) j++; const avg = (i + j) / 2 + 1; for (let k = i; k <= j; k++) r[idx[k][1]] = avg; i = j + 1; } return r; }
function spearman(a, b) { const ra = ranks(a), rb = ranks(b); const n = a.length; const ma = ra.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / n, mb = rb.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / n; let c = 0, va = 0, vb = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { c += (ra[i] - ma) * (rb[i] - mb); va += (ra[i] - ma) ** 2; vb += (rb[i] - mb) ** 2; } return c / Math.sqrt(va * vb); }
function quantile(sorted, p) { const h = (sorted.length - 1) * p; const lo = Math.floor(h); return sorted[lo] + (sorted[Math.min(lo + 1, sorted.length - 1)] - sorted[lo]) * (h - lo); }
function renderWhatIf() {
  const pct = +$('#w-th').value; const sorted = SCORED.map(r => r.oh).sort((a, b) => a - b); const th = quantile(sorted, pct / 100);
  $('#w-th-out').textContent = pct + 'th';
  const above = SCORED.filter(r => r.oh > th), below = SCORED.filter(r => r.oh <= th);
  const mean = L => L.reduce((s, r) => s + r.res, 0) / L.length;
  const ma = mean(above), mb = mean(below);
  // scatter
  const c = $('#c-scatter'); c.innerHTML = '';
  const W = width(c), H = Math.round(Math.min(340, W * 0.8)); const fs = 12;
  const ys = SCORED.map(r => r.res), xs = SCORED.map(r => r.oh);
  const x0 = Math.min(...xs), x1 = Math.max(...xs), y0 = Math.min(...ys), y1 = Math.max(...ys);
  const yt = niceTicks(y0, y1, 5); const ytl = yt.ticks.map(t => tickLabel(t, yt.step));
  const m = { l: Math.max(...ytl.map(s => textW(s, fs))) + 34, r: 10, t: 10, b: 44 };
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, width: W, height: H, role: 'group', 'aria-label': 'Scatter of OPEN_home against breadth residual' }, c);
  const X = v => m.l + (v - x0) / (x1 - x0) * (W - m.l - m.r), Y = v => H - m.b - (v - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (H - m.t - m.b);
  const xt = niceTicks(x0, x1, Math.max(3, Math.floor((W - m.l) / 70)));
  xt.ticks.forEach(t => { el('line', { x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, stroke: 'var(--grid)' }, svg); const tx = el('text', { x: X(t), y: H - m.b + 15, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, class: 'tick' }, svg); tx.textContent = tickLabel(t, xt.step); });
  yt.ticks.forEach((t, i) => { el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: Y(t), y2: Y(t), stroke: t === 0 ? 'var(--ink)' : 'var(--grid)' }, svg); const tx = el('text', { x: m.l - 6, y: Y(t) + 4, 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': fs, class: 'tick' }, svg); tx.textContent = ytl[i]; });
  const xa = el('text', { x: (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, fill: 'var(--muted)' }, svg); xa.textContent = 'OPEN_home (z units)';
  const ya = el('text', { x: 0, y: 0, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, fill: 'var(--muted)', transform: `translate(12 ${(m.t + H - m.b) / 2}) rotate(-90)` }, svg); ya.textContent = 'recorded minus B5 forecast (fields)';
  const gp = el('g', {}, svg);
  SCORED.forEach(r => { el('circle', { cx: X(r.oh), cy: Y(r.res), r: 2.6, fill: r.oh > th ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--base)', 'fill-opacity': 0.55 }, gp); });
  el('line', { x1: X(th), x2: X(th), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, stroke: 'var(--ink)', 'stroke-width': 1.5, 'stroke-dasharray': '5 3' }, svg);
  // marks for keyboard: the two group means as markers on the scatter
  [[below, mb, (x0 + th) / 2, 'var(--base)', 'At or below threshold'], [above, ma, (th + x1) / 2, 'var(--accent)', 'Above threshold']].forEach(([L, mu, xm, col, lab]) => {
    const g = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('rect', { class: 'hit', x: X(xm) - 14, y: Y(mu) - 9, width: 28, height: 18, fill: 'transparent' }, g);
    el('line', { x1: X(xm) - 12, x2: X(xm) + 12, y1: Y(mu), y2: Y(mu), stroke: 'var(--ink)', 'stroke-width': 4 }, g);
    el('line', { x1: X(xm) - 12, x2: X(xm) + 12, y1: Y(mu), y2: Y(mu), stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2 }, g);
    markify(g, `${lab}: mean residual ${sgn(mu, 2)} over ${L.length} concepts`, `<b>${lab}</b><br>mean residual ${sgn(mu, 2)} fields<br>n = ${L.length}`);
  });
  hbars($('#c-split'), [{ label: `OPEN_home ≤ threshold (n=${below.length})`, v: mb, color: 'var(--base)' }, { label: `OPEN_home > threshold (n=${above.length})`, v: ma, color: 'var(--accent)' }], { d: 2, xLabel: 'mean recorded minus B5 forecast (fields)', aria: 'Mean residual by group', domain: [-0.6, 0.6] });
  $('#t-whatif').textContent = `Splitting at the ${pct}th percentile (OPEN_home ${sgn(th, 2)}), the ${above.length} more open concepts end ${sgn(ma, 2)} fields from their B5 forecast on average and the ${below.length} others ${sgn(mb, 2)}: a gap of ${sgn(ma - mb, 2)} fields per 50 papers, small next to the spread of individual misses.`;
}
function renderSpearman() {
  const fp = CO.frozen_prediction;
  const sb = spearman(SCORED.map(r => r.y), SCORED.map(r => r.pB5)), so = spearman(SCORED.map(r => r.y), SCORED.map(r => r.pOP));
  const ok = SCORED.length === fp.n && num(sb, 3) === num(fp.sp_B5, 3) && num(so, 3) === num(fp.sp_OP, 3);
  $('#w-spear').innerHTML = `Forecast quality on the ${SCORED.length} scored concepts, computed in the page: Spearman of the B5 forecast with the outcome ${num(sb, 3)}, of B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> ${num(so, 3)}. The run's file records ${num(fp.sp_B5, 3)} and ${num(fp.sp_OP, 3)} (n = ${fp.n}), a gain of ${sgn(fp.diff, 3)} ${ci(fp.lo, fp.hi, 3, true)} ${ok ? '<span class="pill good">page matches file</span>' : '<span class="pill bad">mismatch</span>'}.`;
}

/* ====================== 8. ENTRY MODEL ====================== */
const EUNIT = { DEV: 'DEV, selection data', PHYS: 'Physical Sciences', LIFEENV: 'Life & Env.', SOC: 'Social Sciences', MATHDEC: 'Math & Decision', COHORT: '2010–14 cohort' };
const SPEC = { e_excl_intersection_born: 'Exclude intersection-born', g_target_field_FE: 'Target-field fixed effects', h_horizon8: 'Horizon 8 years', i_excl_weak_home: 'Exclude weak-home concepts', j_excl_medicine_home: 'Exclude Medicine homes', 'o_label_coverage_ge_0.5': 'Label coverage ≥ 0.5', f_min_n_3: 'Retention min papers 3', f_min_n_5: 'Retention min papers 5', l_rca_entry_event: 'RCA-defined entry event', k_primary_topic_fields: 'Primary-topic fields', m_min_conditional_probability_proximity: 'Min-cp proximity backbone' };
let eView = 'units';
function renderEntry() {
  const c = $('#c-entry'); let t = '';
  if (eView === 'units') {
    const rows = EN.units.map(u => ({ label: EUNIT[u.unit] + ' (n=' + int(u.n) + ')', est: u.d0, lo: u.lo, hi: u.hi, kind: u.unit === 'DEV' ? 'sel' : 'body', shape: 'circle',
      tip: `<b>${esc(EUNIT[u.unit])}</b><br>d₀ ${num(u.d0, 3)} ${ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3)}<br>${int(u.n)} concepts${u.events ? ', ' + int(u.events) + ' entry events' : ''}` }));
    rows.push({ label: 'DL pooled, 4 held-out groups', est: EN.DL.d0, lo: EN.DL.lo, hi: EN.DL.hi, kind: 'pool', sep: true, valText: num(EN.DL.d0, 3) + ' ' + ci(EN.DL.lo, EN.DL.hi, 3) + ', I² = ' + num(EN.DL.I2, 2),
      tip: `<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b><br>${num(EN.DL.d0, 3)} ${ci(EN.DL.lo, EN.DL.hi, 3)}, I² = ${num(EN.DL.I2, 2)}` });
    rows.forEach(r => { if (!r.valText) r.valText = num(r.est, 3) + ' ' + ci(r.lo, r.hi, 3); });
    forest(c, rows, { xLabel: 'Retained-frontier coefficient d₀ (log-odds of entry per SD)', aria: 'd0 by domain group' });
    const pos = EN.units.filter(u => u.unit !== 'DEV' && u.unit !== 'COHORT' && u.lo > 0).length;
    t = `d0 is positive with a CI above zero in ${pos} of 4 held-out groups and in the cohort; Math & Decision (n = 165) is null. The groups disagree strongly on size (I² = ${num(EN.DL.I2, 2)}), and the one-model held-out pool is ${num(EN.pooled.d0, 3)} ${ci(EN.pooled.lo, EN.pooled.hi, 3)}.`;
  } else if (eView === 'specs') {
    const rows = [{ label: 'Primary R3 (held-out pooled)', est: EN.pooled.d0, lo: EN.pooled.lo, hi: EN.pooled.hi, kind: 'body', shape: 'circle', color: 'var(--ink)' }]
      .concat(EN.specs.map(s => ({ label: SPEC[s.id], est: s.d0, kind: s.d0 < 0 ? 'neg' : 'body', shape: 'circle', tip: `<b>${esc(SPEC[s.id])}</b><br>d₀ ${num(s.d0, 3)} (point estimate)` })));

  } else if (eView === 'vol') {
    const v = EN.volume_matched;
    const rows = [
      { label: 'Retained fields, volume-matched', est: v.R, lo: v.R_lo, hi: v.R_hi, kind: 'body', shape: 'circle' },
      { label: 'Entered, not retained, matched', est: v.N, lo: v.N_lo, hi: v.N_hi, kind: 'sel', shape: 'circle' },

    rows.forEach(r => { r.valText = sgn(r.est, 3) + ' ' + ci(r.lo, r.hi, 3, true); r.tip = `<b>${esc(r.label)}</b><br>${r.valText}`; });

function setupTabs() {

function navObserver() {

  function update() {
    const y = window.scrollY + 120; let cur = 0;

}
function renderAll() { renderFinding(); setStage(stage); renderScreen(); renderList(); renderDetail(); renderPairs(); renderWhatIf(); renderEntry(); renderConfound(); }

I built `interactive.html` and linked it from `index.html`. I operated every control in headless Chromium at 390px and 1440px wide: no console errors, no sideways scrolling, and no overlapping chart labels.

**What the page contains** (every chart is drawn from the run's own output files, which are embedded in the page):
- **The finding:** a forest plot of the OPEN-index correlation in the six bodies not used for selection, with the pooled estimate, the development (DEV) set and a shuffled-data placebo band. You can switch the index (OPEN or NOVCHURN), the control rung (R0, R2 or R3) and whether DEV is shown. By default it shows the paper's +0.069 [+0.038, +0.100].
- **How it works:** a 7-stage stepper that follows GPU, or any of the 14 matched-pair concepts, from onset year to the pooled correlation. At stage 4 the page recomputes OPEN from the concept's six recorded components and gets the recorded value exactly. The paper's overview figure sits below it.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - the held-out screen of the 10 indicators, with a per-group breakdown (matches Table 2);
  - a searchable, sortable browser over all 1,443 concepts in the 2015–17 cohort, showing each concept's B5 forecast, its B5+OPEN forecast and the recorded outcome side by side;
  - the matched pairs, with the case-study figure.
- **Try it:**
  - a live OPEN calculator with six sliders, which shows "exact match" at the recorded values;
  - a threshold slider that splits concepts by OPEN and compares how far they beat their B5 forecast, recomputed live. The page also recomputes the forecast correlations (0.768 and 0.770 on 573 concepts) and checks them against the file.
- **Where it fails:** tabs for the field-entry model: by domain group (as in Figure 3), under 11 alternative specifications (the proximity measure that reverses the effect to −0.021), the volume-matched contrast that fails, and the non-monotone dose pattern. After that come a view testing whether the churn signal is noise, and the paper's limitations.
- **Footer:** all links, the source file behind each view, and a 16-term glossary. Term definitions stay open after a click and close with Escape or a tap elsewhere.
